info.title: Bing Webmaster Tools API
info.description: The Bing Webmaster Tools API lets site owners manage and monitor their sites in Bing's index programmatically: add and verify sites, submit URLs and content for indexing, manage sitemaps/feeds, retrieve crawl statistics and issues, query traffic and keyword statistics, manage inbound link data, and configure crawl, URL-normalization, country/region, and page-preview settings. All operations are invoked over a JSON web API at https://ssl.bing.com/webmaster/api.svc/json/{Method} and authenticated with an API key passed as the `apikey` query parameter (generated in the Bing Webmaster Tools portal under Settings > API Access).

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the Bing Webmaster Tools API.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error code (see ApiErrorCode), e.g. InvalidApiKey, ThrottleUser, UserNotAuthorizedToAccessSite.

CrawlStats.description: Crawl statistics for a single day.

UrlWithCrawlIssues.description: A URL that has one or more crawl issues.

Issues.description: Bit flags describing the crawl issues (see UrlWithCrawlIssues.CrawlIssues).

siteUrl.description: The site URL the batch belongs to.

urlList.description: The list of URLs to submit for indexing.

url.description: The URL of the page whose content is being submitted.

httpMessage.description: Base64-encoded full HTTP response (headers + body) for the page.

dynamicServing.description: Dynamic serving type for the content.

Feed.description: A sitemap/feed registered for the site.

QueryStats.description: Traffic statistics for a search query.

DetailedQueryStats.description: Detailed (per-day) statistics for a query or page.

UrlInfo.description: Index details for a single page.
